description: Deployment transform registry. Fill only from a recorded survey/calibration session; null is intentional and unsafe for runtime use.
transform_notation: T_parent_child maps a point from child coordinates into parent coordinates: p_parent = R_parent_child * p_child + t_parent_child.

coordinate_convention.mechanical_frames: +X forward along rail travel toward cutting, +Y left when looking in +X, +Z up; right-handed; SI units.
coordinate_convention.camera_optical_frames: +X image right, +Y image down, +Z out through the lens; right-handed.
coordinate_convention.range_sensor_frames: +X is the positive measured beam direction; distance_m represents [distance_m, 0, 0] only when valid=true.
coordinate_convention.lidar_frame: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up unless the installed MID-360 manual for the exact mounting says otherwise. Record the verified vendor frame in the calibration session.

frame_definitions.map: Optional surveyed site/map frame. Do not use for control until survey control points exist.
frame_definitions.rail_frame: Station frame. Origin is the docking mechanical datum; X follows rail from docking toward cutting.
frame_definitions.base_link: Harvester body datum on the rail centreline. Dynamic pose comes from rail/encoder localisation.
frame_definitions.docking_reference: Fixed docking plane and centreline datum.
frame_definitions.docking_camera_link: Mechanical body frame of the OAK assigned docking_camera.
frame_definitions.docking_camera_optical_frame: Optical frame for its CAM_A RGB stream.
frame_definitions.cutting_camera_link: Mechanical body frame of the OAK assigned cutting_camera.
frame_definitions.cutting_camera_optical_frame: Optical frame for its CAM_A RGB stream.
frame_definitions.mid360_link: Mechanical/LiDAR coordinate frame for the installed MID-360.
frame_definitions.docking_sensor_array_link: Fixed mechanical datum for the five docking range sensors.

dynamic_transforms.contract: T_rail_frame_base_link at the measurement timestamp. For constrained rail motion it begins as translation [rail_position_m, 0, 0] and RPY [0, 0, heading_error_rad], then must be replaced by the measured localisation estimate and covariance.

static_transforms.evidence_required: three-point mechanical survey from the rail datum
